lines.text: The LORD, the King of Jacob, tells the idols to present their case and tell what will happen.
The LORD says the idols are nothing and their work is of no value.
The LORD raised up one from the south who calls on His name and marches over rulers like mortar.
No one announced it beforehand, but the LORD was first to tell Babylon and gave Jerusalem a herald.
The LORD finds no counselor among the idols and calls them all a delusion, their images empty as wind.
